title: Milionario
tagline: Level up the game "1in1 Million" to a complete decentralized version into XMTP and Farcaster ecosystem as a frame
description:
We are developing a decentralized version of the game 1in1 Million where the user has to win 13 plays in a row to be the 1 in 1 million. The user will start a game from an XMTP chatbot (something like /start new 1in1million game), and he will play inside a Farcaster frame.
Every play invokes a call to our smart contract, which generates the bot move and checks if the user won. To play, a user has to pay an amount that fills a pool where the users will take their rewards. A user will receive a reward every time he reaches 6, 9, and 13 wins in a row.
